meta.status: EXPLORATORY - NASA POWER only (MERRA-2 reanalysis + CERES). Uncorrected p-values; BH-FDR q-values provided. MODIS / GPM not yet integrated.
meta.scope_en: A comparison of selected locations across the Congo Basin region (11 points; not a basin-wide average).
meta.scope_fr: Comparaison de lieux sélectionnés dans la région du Bassin du Congo (11 points ; pas une moyenne du bassin).

method.annual_aggregation: day-weighted mean of monthly means; rainfall = sum of mm/day x days in month (leap years counted); complete years only
method.p_mk: Mann-Kendall on annual values (primary test of a monotonic trend)
method.p_smk: Seasonal Mann-Kendall on monthly values, period=12 (is the change consistent across calendar months?). Assumes independence between months, so it can be anti-conservative alone.
method.p_hr: Hamed & Rao (1998) modified MK on annual values: corrects the variance for serial autocorrelation. Robustness check of the same data, not independent validation.
method.rule_RM2: trend_detected if p_mk < 0.05 AND p_smk < 0.05 (conservative: the annual trend must exist and be consistent across seasons); else not_enough_evidence_yet (never 'no change').
method.evidence_level: robust = RM2 AND p_hr < 0.05 AND q_bh < 0.05; exploratory = RM2 only; not_enough_evidence_yet = RM2 false. Note: p_smk is very small almost everywhere (n=300 monthly values, months assumed independent), so in practice p_mk decides RM2.
method.q_bh: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR on the unrounded p_mk within each period family (99 tests). Shown as information; verdict uses RM2.
method.numerics: Annual values are rounded to 6 decimals BEFORE the tests (removes floating-point noise that made mathematically equal years look different) and published at 6 decimals, so every statistic can be reproduced exactly from results.json or results_annual.csv. p-values are published to 3 significant figures; p < 1e-16 from the seasonal test is stored as 0.0 (floating-point limit) and must be displayed as '< 0.001'. Independent re-implementation checks: see validation_report.md.
method.slope: Sen's slope x10 = change per decade; 95% CI Gilbert (1987), normal approximation, NOT corrected for autocorrelation.
method.multiple_comparisons: 198 tests in total (11 zones x 9 variables x 2 periods). Results are exploratory.
method.software: Python 3.13, numpy, pandas, pymannkendall 1.4.3 (original_test, seasonal_test, hamed_rao_modification_test); Sen CI and BH implemented in build_results.py, cross-checked with scipy.stats
